info.title: aptu.dev
info.description: Machine-payable API infrastructure for autonomous agents.
info.x-guidance: All paid endpoints speak x402 v2: an unpaid request receives 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header; sign the exact-scheme authorization (USDC on Base via EIP-3009 or on Solana via the SVM exact scheme, payTo from the challenge) and retry with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header; a settled response carries PAYMENT-RESPONSE with the settlement receipt. Free surfaces are /.well-known/x402, /v1/catalog, /v1/openapi.json, /v1/self-check, GET /v1/x401-probe (401 + PROOF-REQUEST, no payment), and the free partner-registration pair POST /v1/partners + POST /v1/partner-verify. Unauthenticated probes always reach the 402 challenge before request-body validation.

post.description: Typed judging: the Clef model answers your noul, choice, or score questions about JSON state; returns calibrated answers, a settlement receipt, and an Ed25519-signed attestation (JWKS: /.well-known/jwks.json).

state.description: Application state the questions judge: a JSON string, object, or array. Payload cap 256 KiB UTF-8; oversized text state is truncated to the model's 64k-token context rather than rejected.

questions.description: Map of answer name to question spec: {type: noul|choice|score, instructions, criteria?}. 1 to 25 questions; choice criteria up to 255 options; score criteria 2 to 10 ordered levels.

criteria.description: choice: {option: description|null}; score: ordered level descriptions (2-10); omit for noul.

timeout_ms.description: Optional per-request timeout cap in ms (max 60000). The upstream model call is aborted at 4 s regardless.

200.description: Typed answers with model, usage, and a verifiable settlement receipt

PAYMENT-RESPONSE.description: Base64-encoded JSON settlement receipt (x402 v2 PAYMENT-RESPONSE).

answers.description: Map of question name to typed answer. noul: {noul: probability} only. choice: {option, probabilities, confidence}. score: {score, probabilities, confidence}.

noul.description: noul answers: calibrated probability (0-1); the only field on a noul answer.

option.description: choice answers: the chosen option name.

probabilities.description: choice and score answers: per-option or per-level probabilities.

score.description: score answers: the chosen ordered level (1-based).

confidence.description: choice and score answers: calibrated confidence (0-1).

model.description: Producing model id (clef in v1); pin it when re-running a receipt for verification.

usage.description: Token usage metadata for the request.

hash.description: sha256- prefixed SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 canonicalization of {state, questions}; recompute it to verify a published judgment.

attestation.description: Optional Ed25519-signed attestation over this receipt; verify against the public key at /.well-known/jwks.json; proves provenance, not accuracy.

post.summary: Register a partner domain for a challenge
post.description: Self-serve partner registration (free). POST {domain, payout_address}; returns a challenge URL the registrant must serve at https://<domain>/.well-known/aptu-partner/<nonce>. Reserved domains, wildcards, and *.workers.dev domains are rejected.

get.summary: Get a pointer to the partner flow

post.summary: Verify partner domain ownership for a key
post.description: Verifies the pending challenge by fetching https://<domain>/.well-known/aptu-partner/<nonce> (https-only, timeout- and size-capped, no redirects). On match returns a one-time apk_live_ partner key for the X-Aptu-Partner-Key header.

get.summary: Fetch a 401 demand-probe challenge without paying
